items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jon Faddis was conducting it. I wrote a four-movement suite.

ctx.x: Is it the fact that you can change the bells on this trombone?

You can take it off. Why they did that was: the bell is so big that there weren’t a lot of trombone cases that this bell would fit in. They made it another way, so you could take the bell off and put it in a flat case. The whole trombone went in a flat case. This is a special case that they made later, that I can put in the luggage, because a lot of flights are not going to let me take that trombone on there, and I’m not going to argue with them about it. I like the non-problematic style of life. So I found an…
We ended yesterday talking about your time in Europe. I know I’d asked you about – is it Joe Haider? How do you say it?
